#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <string>

int compute(std::vector<char>& s, char x) {
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == 'X') {
            s[i] = x;
        }
    }
    if (s[0] == '0') {
        return 0;
    }
    int total = 1;
    bool firstX = true;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < s.size(); ++i) {
        if (s[i] == '_') {
            total *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
        } else if (s[i] == 'X' && firstX) {
            total *= (i == 0) ? 9 : 10;
            firstX = false;
        }
    }
    return total;
}

bool checkReplace(const std::vector<char>& s, char a, char b) {
    size_t n = s.size();
    if (n < 2) return true; // Edge case, though in main code length >= 2
    if (s[n - 2] >= '0' && s[n - 2] <= '9' && s[n - 2] != a) {
        return false;
    }
    if (s[n - 1] >= '0' && s[n - 1] <= '9' && s[n - 1] != b) {
        return false;
    }
    if (s[n - 2] == 'X' && s[n - 1] == 'X' && a != b) {
        return false;
    }
    return true;
}

int main() {
    std::string input;
    std::getline(std::cin, input);
    std::vector<char> s(input.begin(), input.end());
    int n = s.size();

    if (n < 2) {
        if (s[0] == '0' || s[0] == '_' || s[0] == 'X') {
            std::cout << 1 << std::endl;
        } else {
            std::cout << 0 << std::endl;
        }
        return 0;
    }

    int answer = 0;

    std::vector<std::pair<char, char>> replacements = {
        {'0', '0'},
        {'2', '5'},
        {'5', '0'},
        {'7', '5'}
    };

    for (const auto& rep : replacements) {
        if (checkReplace(s, rep.first, rep.second)) {
            std::vector<char> t = s;
            t[n - 2] = rep.first;
            t[n - 1] = rep.second;
            if (s[n - 2] == 'X') {
                answer += compute(t, t[n - 2]);
            } else if (s[n - 1] == 'X') {
                answer += compute(t, t[n - 1]);
            } else {
                answer += compute(t, 'X');
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << answer << std::endl;
    return 0;
}
